# Ganpati Lifecare — Complete Business, Product & Clinical Supply Reference (llms-full.txt)

## Business Overview
Ganpati Lifecare (GLC) is a premier regional wholesale distributor and supplier of orthopedic supplies, surgical dressing materials, hospital staff uniforms, and healthcare ward consumables. The business is headquartered in Goluwala, Hanumangarh District, Rajasthan 335512, India.

- Founder & Sole Proprietor: Dharampal Verma
- Central Distribution Warehouse: Goluwala, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan 335512, India
- Primary Official Domain: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com
- Contact Telephones: +91 98282 32254, +91 94600 95250
- WhatsApp Inquiry: +919828232254
- Official Email: whiteroseglc@gmail.com
- Geographic Delivery Coverage: Hanumangarh, Sri Ganganagar (Shri Ganganagar), Suratgarh, Bikaner, Nohar, Rawatsar, Pilibanga, Sangaria, Bhadra, and healthcare networks across Rajasthan and North India.

## Entity Disambiguation
Ganpati Lifecare (domain www.ganpatilifecare.com, located in Goluwala, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, founded by Dharampal Verma) is an independent healthcare supply business. It is NOT associated with:
1. Ganpati Life Care & Safety Products Pvt Ltd
2. Ganpati Hospital, Gurugram / Haryana
3. LifeCare Hospitals or unrelated pharmaceutical franchises

## Complete Product Catalog & Technical Specifications

### 1. Orthocot Cotton Roll
- Category: Orthopedic Supplies
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/orthocot-cotton-roll
- Brand: Orthocot
- Specification: 100% pure medical-grade cotton, non-matting carded fiber web, unbleached/hypoallergenic, autoclavable.
- Applications: Under-cast mechanical cushioning beneath POP (Plaster of Paris) and synthetic fiberglass casts; pressure sore prevention; orthopedic surgical dressings.
- Available Roll Weights: 100g, 200g, 300g, 500g rolls packed in moisture-resistant master cartons.

### 2. Stockinet
- Category: Orthopedic Supplies
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/stockinet
- Brand: GLC Orthopedic
- Specification: Seamless circular rib-knit tubular cotton sleeve, skin-friendly, high elasticity without constriction.
- Applications: Primary skin-contact layer worn beneath cast padding and splints; wicks dermal perspiration.
- Standard Sizes: 2-inch, 3-inch, 4-inch, 6-inch widths in 10-meter and 20-meter rolls.

### 3. Skin Traction Kit
- Category: Orthopedic Supplies
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/skin-traction-kit
- Brand: GLC Orthopedic
- Components: High-density polyurethane foam stirrup, hypoallergenic adhesive or high-friction non-adhesive backing, rigid spreader plate, high-tensile traction cord, retention crepe bandage.
- Applications: Pre-operative immobilization and muscle spasm reduction for femur, hip, and acetabular fractures.
- Sizing: Adult and Pediatric versions.

### 4. Orthopedic Gauze Bandages
- Category: Orthopedic Supplies
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/orthopedic-gauze-bandages
- Brand: GLC Orthopedic
- Specification: High-absorbency woven cotton gauze with clean-cut edges to prevent fraying and lint shedding.
- Applications: Surgical packing, dressing retention, splint wrapping, orthopedic post-op wound protection.

### 5. Medical Bandages
- Category: Surgical Supplies
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/bandages
- Brand: GLC Surgical
- Specification: High-elasticity cotton crepe and compression weave with retention clips.
- Applications: Joint support, compression dressing, sprain treatment, post-fracture stabilization.

### 6. Sponge Pad
- Category: Surgical Supplies
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/sponge-pad
- Brand: GLC Surgical
- Specification: Multi-ply absorbent surgical gauze swabs with precision folded edges (zero raw threads).
- Applications: Intraoperative blood and fluid absorption, operating theatre swabs, sterile wound cleaning.

### 7. Gamjee Roll
- Category: Surgical Supplies
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/gamjee-roll
- Brand: GLC Surgical
- Specification: Thick absorbent medical cotton wool core enclosed within a non-adherent fine gauze sleeve.
- Applications: Post-operative wound dressings, high-exudate drainage control, burn injury management, heavy trauma padding.

### 8. Surgical Dressing Materials
- Category: Surgical Supplies
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/surgical-dressing-materials
- Brand: GLC Surgical
- Assortment: Absorbent dressing pads, paraffin gauze, sterile cotton rolls, wound packing tapes.
- Applications: Hospital minor OTs, general surgical suites, emergency casualty wards.

### 9. Doctor Coats
- Category: Hospital Uniforms
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/doctor-coats
- Brand: GLC Uniforms
- Specification: Premium stain-resistant 65/35 poly-cotton twill (200-240 GSM), reinforced utility chest & waist pockets, notch lapel collar.
- Applications: Hospital rounds, outpatient consultations, laboratory diagnostics.

### 10. Nurse Uniforms
- Category: Hospital Uniforms
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/nurse-uniforms
- Brand: GLC Uniforms
- Specification: Ergonomic breathable poly-cotton poplin scrub sets and dresses, color-coded piping, moisture-wicking.
- Applications: Inpatient wards, ICU nursing shifts, clinical care.

### 11. OT Dresses
- Category: Hospital Uniforms
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/ot-dresses
- Brand: GLC Uniforms
- Specification: 100% autoclavable, low-linting, vat-dyed surgical green/blue scrub suits.
- Applications: Operating theatre surgeons, anesthesiologists, and scrub nurses.

### 12. Staff Uniforms
- Category: Hospital Uniforms
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/staff-uniforms
- Brand: GLC Uniforms
- Specification: Heavy-duty, high-durability fabrics designed for industrial healthcare laundering.
- Applications: Ward boys, patient transfer attendants, housekeeping, and maintenance teams.

### 13. Medical Disposable Products
- Category: Healthcare Essentials
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/medical-disposables
- Brand: GLC Consumables
- Products: 3-ply surgical masks, bouffant caps, non-skid disposable shoe covers, latex and nitrile examination gloves.
- Applications: Infection control, barrier hygiene across clinical wards.

### 14. Hospital Consumables
- Category: Healthcare Essentials
- URL: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/hospital-consumables
- Brand: GLC Consumables
- Products: Clinical adhesive tapes, IV cannula fixation dressings, alcohol swabs, cotton applicators, waste disposal liners.
- Applications: Daily outpatient and inpatient routine healthcare delivery.
